items.claim: Shift on an edge handle breaks aspect and goes under the minimum
items.note: The same bug also hit Shift on a corner handle, and that is fixed in the same commit.

items.claim: An axis with no minimum collapses to zero instead of flipping
items.note: The public `clampMinSize` constraint behaves the same way now.

items.claim: A flipped node with a minimum unflips and jumps, and a flipped member of a shared box is left out of the minimum
Transform Again doesn't hold a frame's contents in place
Transform Again skips the output grid
items.note: The scene's quantize pass already put the result on the grid, but it knows no anchor, so the anchored side moved. `posesInBox` now quantizes with the anchor and holds contents, and the drag and the command both go through it.

items.claim: Transform Again records the dragged box when a constraint's `onEnd` committed its own ops (A+B, B's half b)
items.note: This was a behavior call: in that case nothing is recorded, so Cmd+D duplicates. It's recorded in `docs/unruled.md` under "Scene, move, and history".

items.claim: Transform Again records the box from before quantization (B, half a)
items.note: A resize repeats as a proportion (`docs/unruled.md`, 2026-10-14), and since 2d077c13ec the replay quantizes the same way the drag does. Recording the rounded box would round each repeat twice.

items.claim: A flipped frame's held children are posed against the signed preview, not the normalized pose that commits
